skill.name: alicloud-redis
skill.description: Manage Alibaba Cloud Redis (Tair / R-KVStore) using the @alicloud/r-kvstore20150101 TypeScript SDK. Use when working with Redis or Tair instances, accounts, backups, security (whitelist/SSL/TDE/audit), parameters, monitoring, cluster scaling, direct connection, Tair Custom instances, and resource tagging. Covers all 157 APIs of the R-KVStore 20150101 version.

generated_query: I need to set up a new Alibaba Cloud Redis instance for my application, configure it with a specific password and security group, adjust some parameters like eviction policy and timeout, then create a backup and restore it to a new instance for testing. Also, I want to enable SSL for secure connections and tag both instances with environment tags. Can you help me write the code to do this step by step using the Alibaba Cloud SDK? I'll provide my access key and secret, region (cn-shanghai), and the exact instance specs: Redis 7.0, master-slave, 4GB, with a whitelist of my office IPs. The first instance should be named "prod-redis" and the restored one "test-redis".
